item.title: Jazz in the Plaza — Sun Oct 4, 1:00 PM — Putnam Plaza
item.description:
Every Sunday: Free, live jazz every week performed by some of the best musicians in the SF Bay Area and beyond, right in the heart of downtown Petaluma! Every Sunday from 1 to 3:30, local jazz bassist and music book publisher Chuck Sher presents a rotating ensemble of professional, veteran jazz musicians in Putnam Plaza Park, right next to the Speakeasy. This event started in 2020 and has since become a staple for locals and visitors alike. Stop by and enjoy some of the best jazz the Bay Area has to offer!

item.title: Let's Play Chinese Mahjong! — Mon Oct 5, 3:00 PM — Windsor Regional Library
item.description:
Learn to play Chinese \(Hong Kong-style\) mahjong, or come play with friends if you already know the game! We will have sets and instructors on site to teach the game and help with rules and scoring. Mahjong is a game for multi-generations; it keeps the mind sharp with a basic set of rules that can be learned in 30 minutes, and adds unending ways to add strategy and challenge; it builds community and sustains culture; it's fun and addicting in a wholesome way! 'Four Flowers Mahjong Salon' goal is to bring mahjong to the Sonoma County area. They currently teach at private homes, farmers markets, tasting rooms, and coffee shops!
Source: North Bay Bohemian
